name: Denial
overview: Scripture calls believers to a life of self-denial, exemplified by Jesus' call to take up the cross daily and follow Him, which means putting God's will above personal desires (Luke 9:23). Loving God wholeheartedly and obeying His commandments is central to this commitment (Luke 10:27; John 14:15). True faith rejects the compromise of righteousness before evil and embraces joyful service to the Lord, reflecting a heart aligned with His abundant blessings (Proverbs 25:26; Deuteronomy 28:47).
